entry.name: RowHeight
entry.label: Height of a desktop row, in percent of the screen height

entry.name: BlurBehindWindows
entry.label: Blur the wallpaper behind windows, like KWin's blur behind translucent windows

entry.name: ColorCorrection
entry.label: Color blindness correction in the overview, like KWin's effect, which doesn't reach it: 0 none, 1 protanopia, 2 deuteranopia, 3 tritanopia, 4 grayscale

entry.name: ColorCorrectionIntensity
entry.label: Intensity of the color blindness correction, in percent

entry.name: ShowMinimized
entry.label: Show minimized windows at the end of their desktop

entry.name: CenterOnClick
entry.label: Clicking a window centers it on the screen, otherwise Karousel only scrolls as far as needed

entry.name: SearchFieldShown
entry.label: The search field is always shown, otherwise only once typing starts

entry.name: SearchWindows
entry.label: Typing filters the windows too, otherwise it only searches KRunner's results, apps and more

entry.name: SearchWindowsFirst
entry.label: Typing goes to the matching windows first, otherwise to KRunner's results, apps and more

entry.name: ShowDropMinimap
entry.label: Show small desktops along the right edge when the pointer reaches it and while dragging a window, to go to or drop it on any of them

entry.name: MinimapAlwaysShown
entry.label: Always show the desktop minimap, not only when the pointer reaches its edge or a window is dragged

entry.name: DropMinimapAtTop
entry.label: Show the desktop minimap as a row along the top instead of a column along the right edge

entry.name: ShowNewDesktopRow
entry.label: Show a "New desktop" row after the last desktop, to create a desktop by clicking it or dropping a window on it

entry.name: RemoveEmptyDesktops
entry.label: Remove desktops created in the overview once they have no windows, when the overview closes, except the current one

entry.name: TouchpadGesture
entry.label: Open and close the overview with a vertical touchpad swipe
